title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: Suspended in cool twilight water lit by softly glowing anemones, this pint-sized octopod flaps its ear-like fins while meticulously arranging iridescent sea-glass into neat spirals on the sandy floor. Whenever inspiration strikes, it traces fleeting constellations in the silt with a single tentacle tip before hovering back to admire its work.
